chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.enab: Master switch. When 'tis false, the vanilla Anvil region files be used unchanged. Turning it off doth NOT convert anything: existing .cso files bide on disk, and chunks stored only therein become invisible to the vanilla reader.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.grid: Bucket grid edge length. A 32x32 region is split into grid x grid buckets. Larger grid = smaller buckets = lower write amplification, but weaker compression. It applieth only to region files newly created; existing files keep the grid they were born with. Measured upon an 889 MB city save: grid 16 doth roughly halve write volume and write time against grid 8, for about 7.5% more space. Grid 32 fareth worse than 16 - one chunk per bucket loseth the benefit of sharing a compression context. 1 = the whole region is one bucket (best ratio, worst write cost; cold archives). 8 = 16 chunks per bucket. 16 = 4 chunks per bucket (default: lowest write cost).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.comp: The codec of compression: zstd or none.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.zstd: The zstd degree for the hot write path. 3 is the default trade-off; higher degrees compress better and write slower.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.cach: Decompressed buckets hoarded in memory per region file. Higher values lessen read amplification near the player, at the cost of heap. The cache is also bounded by an 8 MB per-file budget — at small grids a single bucket can hold a whole region's worth of chunks, and one larger than the budget is not cached at all. A bucket holds up to (32/grid)^2 chunks; at grid=8 that is 16 chunks.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.veri: Prove each bucket's CRC32 upon reading. It detecteth corruption rather than silently returning garbage or empty chunks. Keep this on unless thou art benchmarking.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.fall: When a chunk is absent from the .cso file, retreat to reading the legacy .mca. This maketh the mod safe to enable upon an existing world: nothing already saved is lost, and new writes move by degrees to the new format.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.comp: The least number of wasted bytes before a region file be compacted.
The least wasted/live ratio before compaction comes to pass (0.25 = 25% waste).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.batc: Writing one chunk meaneth recompressing its whole bucket, so writes be staged and flushed per bucket: N chunks in one bucket cost but one compression, not N. This is how many chunks to stage before flushing early. Set it to 1 and batching ceaseth.
The longest time staged writes may sit in memory ere they be forced to disk. It boundeth how much is lost if the process dieth. Autosave flusheth regardless.
